sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: Earlier this month, a man named Brian Chesky sent out an email that began like this.
sentences.zh: 本月初，一位名叫布莱恩·切斯基（Brian Chesky）的男士发出了一封邮件，开头是这样写的。

sentences.en: At the heart of our mission, he wrote, is the idea that people are fundamentally good
sentences.zh: 他写道，我们使命的核心理念是：人们本质上是善良的，

sentences.en: and every community is a place where you can belong.
sentences.zh: 每一个社区都是你可以归属的地方。

sentences.en: Chesky is the CEO and co-founder of Airbnb,
sentences.zh: 切斯基是爱彼迎（Airbnb）的首席执行官兼联合创始人，

sentences.en: the online marketplace that connects travelers with people looking to rent their homes.
sentences.zh: 这是一个连接旅行者与房屋出租者的在线市场平台。

sentences.en: Chesky's email, sent to users across the globe, was a response to concerns about racial bias.
sentences.zh: 切斯基发给全球用户的这封邮件，是为了回应人们对种族偏见的担忧。

sentences.en: Some guests say they've experienced prejudice while trying to book rooms on Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 一些房客表示，他们在尝试通过爱彼迎预订房间时遭遇了歧视。

sentences.en: We first explored these complaints in the spring in an episode titled Airbnb While Black.
sentences.zh: 我们曾在春季的一期节目中首次探讨过这些投诉，那期节目的标题是《黑人使用爱彼迎》（Airbnb While Black）。

sentences.en: The host would always come up with excuses like, oh, someone actually just booked it.
sentences.zh: 房东总是会找借口，比如，哦，刚好有人预订了。

sentences.en: But I got suspicious when I would check back like days later and see that those dates are still available.
sentences.zh: 但当我几天后再去查看，发现那些日期依然显示可预订时，我就开始怀疑了。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to bring you that episode again with a few updates to reflect changes the company says it's making.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将再次为您播出那期节目，并加入一些更新内容，以反映该公司声称正在做出的改变。

sentences.en: We'll begin not with Airbnb, but with another online platform you may have heard of, Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们先不谈爱彼迎，而是从另一个你可能听说过的在线平台——脸书（Facebook）说起。

sentences.en: So a few months back, I was on Facebook when a friend request came in.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我正在刷脸书，收到了一条好友请求。

sentences.en: I don't have a great memory for faces and names,
sentences.zh: 我对人脸和名字的记忆力不太好，

sentences.en: so I found myself trying to figure out if I had met this person somewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在想，自己是否在什么地方见过这个人。

sentences.en: But then, at the back of my mind, I remembered a study.
sentences.zh: 但随后，我脑海深处想起了一项研究。

sentences.en: It said my friendship choices on Facebook might be shaped by biases outside of my conscious awareness.
sentences.zh: 研究称，我在脸书上的好友选择可能受到我意识之外的偏见影响。

sentences.en: Michelle Hebel is a psychologist at Rice University who ran the Facebook study.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·赫贝尔（Michelle Hebel）是莱斯大学的一位心理学家，她主持了这项脸书研究。

sentences.en: She designed fictitious Facebook profiles for two men and two women.
sentences.zh: 她为两男两女设计了虚构的脸书个人资料。

sentences.en: Both men were named Michael Davis.
sentences.zh: 两位男性都叫迈克尔·戴维斯（Michael Davis）。

sentences.en: Both women were Jennifer Davis.
sentences.zh: 两位女性都叫詹妮弗·戴维斯（Jennifer Davis）。

sentences.en: All the characters were African American.
sentences.zh: 所有角色都是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: The only real difference between the profiles were the photos.
sentences.zh: 这些资料之间唯一的真正区别就是照片。

sentences.en: One Photoshop version of Michael Davis and Jennifer Davis had lighter skin.
sentences.zh: 其中一个经过PS处理的迈克尔·戴维斯和詹妮弗·戴维斯版本肤色较浅。

sentences.en: The other Photoshop version had darker skin.
sentences.zh: 另一个PS版本肤色较深。

sentences.en: Mickey Hebel sent out friend requests on behalf of these fictitious characters
sentences.zh: 米奇·赫贝尔（Mickey Hebel）以这些虚构角色的名义发出了好友请求，

sentences.en: to more than a thousand people in a big American city.
sentences.zh: 发给了美国某大城市的一千多人。

sentences.en: Since these were invented characters, most of the requests were declined.
sentences.zh: 由于这些是虚构人物，大多数请求都被拒绝了。

sentences.en: But there was a big disparity in how often whites accepted friend requests
sentences.zh: 但在白人接受好友请求的频率上，存在巨大的差异，

sentences.en: from the darker-skinned Michaels and Jennifers.
sentences.zh: 即他们接受肤色较深的迈克尔和詹妮弗请求的频率。

sentences.en: People were less likely to friend them.
sentences.zh: 人们不太愿意加他们为好友。

sentences.en: They were less likely particularly to friend the dark, black males.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对于肤色较深的黑人男性，他们更不愿意加为好友。

sentences.en: If you follow these kinds of experiments, this finding is disappointing, but not surprising.
sentences.zh: 如果你关注这类实验，这个发现虽然令人失望，但并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Using similar experimental methods, researchers have found disparities in the way professors
sentences.zh: 利用类似的实验方法，研究人员发现教授在对待学生的方式上，

sentences.en: spend time with students, how companies select job applicants for interviews,
sentences.zh: 公司在筛选面试申请人的方式上，

sentences.en: even how legislators respond to constituents.
sentences.zh: 甚至立法者在回应选民的方式上，都存在差异。

sentences.en: But something new is happening today.
sentences.zh: 但今天出现了一些新的情况。

sentences.en: The biased decisions we once made in interpersonal settings are now being made on giant online
sentences.zh: 我们曾经在人际交往中做出的偏见决策，现在正发生在巨大的在线平台上，

sentences.en: platforms where our actions have the potential to affect many more people.
sentences.zh: 在这些平台上，我们的行为有可能影响更多的人。

sentences.en: Think about the way you might look for a roommate.
sentences.zh: 想想你寻找室友的方式。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, you may have put up a flyer on a bulletin board and talked to people who responded.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，你可能会在公告栏上贴传单，并与回应的人交谈。

sentences.en: Today, you might turn to sites such as roommates.com or CraigsliSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，你可能会转向roommates.com或Craigslist这样的网站。

sentences.en: Raj Ghoshal, a sociologist at Goucher College in Baltimore,
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩古彻学院（Goucher College）的社会学家拉杰·戈沙尔（Raj Ghoshal），

sentences.en: recently conducted a roommate study on Craigslist using a technique similar to the one
sentences.zh: 最近在Craigslist上进行了一项室友研究，使用的方法与米奇·赫贝尔在脸书上使用的类似。

sentences.en: Mickey Hebel used on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们确实发现了一种偏好或偏见模式，即偏向听起来像白人的名字。

sentences.en: We definitely found a pattern of preference or bias in favor of white-sounding names.
sentences.zh: 所以，听起来像白人的名字每收到100条回复，拉丁裔名字大约收到75条，

sentences.en: So for every 100 replies that a white-sounding name got, a Latina name got about 75,
sentences.zh: 而非裔美国人的名字大约收到65条左右。

sentences.en: and an African-American name got about 65 or something like that.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的差异。

sentences.en: That is a huge difference.
sentences.zh: 差异相当大，对吧？

sentences.en: It's a pretty big difference, right?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是非裔美国人，你申请住房所花费的时间，

sentences.en: So if you're African-American, you'd have to spend about one and a half times
sentences.zh: 大约是拥有白人名字的人的1.5倍。

sentences.en: as much time applying for housing as would somebody with a white name.
sentences.zh: 在今天的播客中，我们将深入探讨当陈旧的偏见在生活中一个新兴且不断增长的部分——有时被称为“共享经济”——中抬头时会发生什么。

sentences.en: On today's podcast, we're going to delve into what happens when age-old biases rear their heads
sentences.zh: 如果我想歧视周五晚上邀请谁来家里吃晚饭，或者邀请谁来家里过夜，那是一回事。

sentences.en: in a new and growing part of our lives, what's sometimes called the sharing economy.
sentences.zh: 但当我的私人住宅开始变成我的生意时，情况就不同了。

sentences.en: It's one thing if I want to discriminate about who I'm going to have over on Friday night
sentences.zh: 共享经济，即那些允许你打车、叫保姆、在爱彼迎上找房间的平台，

sentences.en: to have for dinner or who I want to have sleep over.
sentences.zh: 依赖于将曾经的商业交换变成半个人化的交易。

sentences.en: But it's another thing when my private house starts to become my business.
sentences.zh: 你的优步（Uber）司机能看到你的名字和照片。

sentences.en: The sharing economy, platforms that allow you to hail a taxi, call a babysitter, find a room on Airbnb,
sentences.zh: 你也能看到司机的名字和照片。

sentences.en: rely on making what used to be business exchanges into semi-personal transactions.
sentences.zh: 这本应增加信任，而且有充分的理由认为它确实做到了。

sentences.en: Your Uber driver sees your name and photograph.
sentences.zh: 但它也带来了别的影响。

sentences.en: You see your driver's name and photo.
sentences.zh: 当你向人们提供名字时，你就提供了关于你种族的信息。

sentences.en: It's supposed to increase trust, and there's every reason to think it does.
sentences.zh: 你提供的信息可以让人们去搜索你，并找出更多关于你的线索。

sentences.en: But it also does something else.
sentences.zh: 这就成了问题。

sentences.en: When you give people names, then you give people information about your ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 我采访米奇时，她正在一艘船上。

sentences.en: You give people information that they can use to look you up and figure out more cues about you.
sentences.zh: 她正在参加“海上学期”（Semester at Sea）的教学。

sentences.en: And that becomes problematic.
sentences.zh: 她说，在漫长的航行中，学生们告诉她他们正在使用许多在线平台。

sentences.en: Mickey was on a ship when I interviewed her.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫care.com的网站，这是一个保姆网站，人们在上面宣传自己是保姆，

sentences.en: She's teaching a semester at sea.
sentences.zh: 他们必须放上自己的照片。

sentences.en: During the long voyage, she says, her students tell her about the many online platforms that they are using.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想到，也许我不想雇佣那个种族的保姆。

sentences.en: There's a website called care.com, and it's a babysitting website where people advertise themselves as babysitters,
sentences.zh: 也许我不想雇佣那个性别的保姆。

sentences.en: and they have to put a picture of themselves on.
sentences.zh: 于是你开始看到这种非常微妙的歧视是如何变得非常系统化的。

sentences.en: So you can think about how, again, maybe I don't want a babysitter that is of that race.
sentences.zh: 共享经济正在释放我们生活中新的可能性。

sentences.en: Maybe I don't want a babysitter that is of that gender.
sentences.zh: 这些平台让我们能够结识更多人，去更多地方，建立更多联系。

sentences.en: And so you begin to see where this very subtle type of discrimination can be very systemic.
sentences.zh: 我个人是许多应用程序的粉丝。

sentences.en: The sharing economy is unleashing new possibilities in our lives.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说也很清楚，这些平台提供了一种放大我们集体偏见的机制。

sentences.en: These platforms allow us to meet more people, visit more places, get more connected.
sentences.zh: 这些平台上偏见最阴险的地方在于，其后果在很大程度上是隐藏的。

sentences.en: I'm personally a fan of many apps.
sentences.zh: 如果你的保姆申请被拒绝，你无法知道这是否是由种族偏见驱动的。

sentences.en: But it also seems clear to me that these platforms provide a mechanism to amplify our collective bias.
sentences.zh: 所以我请《隐藏的大脑》制作人玛吉·彭曼（Maggie Penman）和马克斯·内斯特拉克（Max Nestrack）花几周时间，尝试寻找那些受到此类偏见影响的人。

sentences.en: What's especially insidious about the biases on these platforms is that their consequences are largely hidden.
sentences.zh: 他们决定专注于共享经济中一个重要的新部分：爱彼迎。

sentences.en: If your request to be a babysitter gets turned down, you have no way of knowing if this was driven by racial bias.
sentences.zh: 想象一下你正和朋友去度假。

sentences.en: So I asked Hidden Brain producers Maggie Penman and Max Nestrack to take a few weeks and try to find people
sentences.zh: 你在网上快速搜索，在你想要入住的城市找到几家酒店。

sentences.en: who were personally affected by such biases.
sentences.zh: 你选了一家，最好带热水浴缸，然后输入你的信用卡信息。

sentences.en: They decided to focus on an important new part of the sharing economy, Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，你心想。

sentences.en: Imagine you're going on vacation with some friends.
sentences.zh: 一切搞定。

sentences.en: You do a quick search online, find a few hotels in the city you'd like to stay in.
sentences.zh: 但随后你收到了一封邮件。

sentences.en: You pick one, ideally with a hot tub, and enter your credit card information.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，你刚才预订的日期其实无法预订。

sentences.en: Great, you think.
sentences.zh: 它们被错误地列出来了。

sentences.en: All set.
sentences.zh: 如果这种事发生在你身上一次，你可能会把它归咎于网站的奇怪故障。

sentences.en: But then you get an email.
sentences.zh: 但如果它一次又一次地发生在你身上，你就会觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: We're sorry, but the dates you just booked aren't available after all.
sentences.zh: 你可能会开始觉得，是因为你自身的原因，才让这些酒店突然变得无法预订。

sentences.en: They were listed by mistake.
sentences.zh: 这正是科蒂娜·克里滕登（Cortina Crittenden）在尝试使用爱彼迎与朋友预订度假时所感受到的。

sentences.en: Now if this happened to you once, you might chalk it up to a weird website glitch.
sentences.zh: 她会找到一处显示可预订的房子，发送预订请求。

sentences.en: But if it happened to you over and over, something would start to feel funny.
sentences.zh: 然后我总是被拒绝。

sentences.en: You might start to feel like it's something about you that's making these hotels suddenly unavailable.
sentences.zh: 科蒂娜收到了很多类似的回复。

sentences.en: This is exactly how Cortina Crittenden felt when she would try to use Airbnb to book vacations with her friends.
sentences.zh: 房东总是会找借口，比如：

sentences.en: She would find a house that was listed as available, send a booking requeSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，刚好有人预订了。

sentences.en: And I would get declined all the time.
sentences.zh: 或者，哦，我的一些常客要来城里，他们要住在那儿。

sentences.en: Cortina got a bunch of similar responses.
sentences.zh: 我只是还没更新日历。

sentences.en: The host would always come up with excuses like,
sentences.zh: 但当我几天后再去查看，发现那些日期依然显示可预订时，我就开始怀疑了。

sentences.en: Oh, someone actually just booked it.
sentences.zh: 科蒂娜是黑人。

sentences.en: Or, oh, some of my regulars are coming in town and they're going to stay there.
sentences.zh: 这一点很重要，因为在爱彼迎上，房东和房客的名字和照片都会显眼地显示在个人资料上。

sentences.en: I just haven't updated my calendar.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是该平台的卖点之一。

sentences.en: But I got suspicious when I would check back like days later and see that those dates are still available.
sentences.zh: 它本应让陌生人之间的交易感觉不那么匿名，也不那么可怕。

sentences.en: Cortina is black.
sentences.zh: 但这也让科蒂娜开始怀疑，这些拒绝是否与她的种族有关。

sentences.en: And this is relevant because on Airbnb, both hosts and guests have their names and photos prominently displayed on their profiles.
sentences.zh: 我叫科蒂娜。

sentences.en: And this is actually one of the platform's selling points.
sentences.zh: 我的名字听起来非常像黑人名字。

sentences.en: It's supposed to make these transactions between strangers feel less anonymous and less scary.
sentences.zh: 而且我也放了我的照片。

sentences.en: But it also made Cortina start to wonder if these rejections had something to do with her race.
sentences.zh: 所以我很明显是一位黑人女性。

sentences.en: My name is Cortina.
sentences.zh: 当她查看之前房客留给这些房东的评价时，

sentences.en: I have a very black sounding name.
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过长得像我的人。

sentences.en: And I also had my photo.
sentences.zh: 所以科蒂娜做了任何一个千禧一代在感到沮丧时会做的事。

sentences.en: So I'm very clearly a black woman.
sentences.zh: 她上了推特（Twitter）。

sentences.en: And when she looked at the reviews that previous guests had left for these hosts.
sentences.zh: 我只是在发泄我的沮丧。

sentences.en: I never saw anybody who looked like me.
sentences.zh: 我附上了很多我从别人那里收到的消息截图。

sentences.en: So Cortina did what any good millennial does when they're frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我加上了标签“黑人使用爱彼迎”。

sentences.en: She took to Twitter.
sentences.zh: 她开始收到许多有类似经历的朋友的消息。

sentences.en: And I was just venting my frustrations.
sentences.zh: 我得到的最常见的回复是，哦，是啊，这就是为什么我不放照片。

sentences.en: And I just included a lot of screenshots of the messages that I was getting from people.
sentences.zh: 就像，废话。

sentences.en: And I put the hashtag Airbnb while black.
sentences.zh: 就像，我是最后一个知道的。

sentences.en: She started hearing from lots of friends who had similar experiences.
sentences.zh: 还有一位没这么做的朋友。

sentences.en: The most common response that I got was, oh, yeah, that's why I don't use my photo.
sentences.zh: 我的一位黑人朋友回复我说，嗯，我从来没遇到过问题。

sentences.en: Like, duh.
sentences.zh: 然后他回去检查了他的个人资料。

sentences.en: Like, I was the late one.
sentences.zh: 我想他从来没想过要用自己的照片。

sentences.en: And one friend who hadn't.
sentences.zh: 所以他意识到，一直以来他用的都是我们学校里某个随机白人男生的照片。

sentences.en: One of my friends who was actually black, he responded to me and said, well, I've never had an issue.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，哦，也许这就是我从来没遇到过问题的原因。

sentences.en: And then he went back and checked his profile.
sentences.zh: 于是科蒂娜决定调整她的个人资料。

sentences.en: And I guess he never wanted to use his photo.
sentences.zh: 我把名字缩短为蒂娜（Tina），这是我在工作和其他场合使用的名字。

sentences.en: So he realized that the whole time he had been using a photo of some random white guy from our school.
sentences.zh: 我把照片换成了一张风景照。

sentences.en: And so he's like, oh, maybe this is why I've never had an issue.
sentences.zh: 自从我改了名字和照片后，我在爱彼迎上就再也没遇到过任何问题。

sentences.en: So Cortina decided to tweak her profile.
sentences.zh: 现在，无法确切说明为什么科蒂娜会被那些特定的房东拒绝。

sentences.en: I shortened my name to just Tina, which is a name that I go by in work and in other settings.
sentences.zh: 但最近的一项研究表明，爱彼迎上的种族歧视非常普遍。

sentences.en: And I changed my photo to a landscape.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·卢卡（Michael Luca）。

sentences.en: Ever since I changed my name and my photo, I've never had any issues on Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 我是哈佛商学院的教员。

sentences.en: Now, it's impossible to say exactly why Cortina was rejected by those specific hosts.
sentences.zh: 我是工商管理助理教授。

sentences.en: But a recent study shows racial discrimination on Airbnb is widespread.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·卢卡和他的同事本杰明·阿德尔曼（Benjamin Adelman）以及丹·萨维尔斯基（Dan Savierski）向现实中的房东发送了虚假的爱彼迎请求。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Luca.
sentences.zh: 我们发出了6400个住宿请求。

sentences.en: I'm a faculty member at Harvard Business School.
sentences.zh: 我们保持每个请求的内容一致。

sentences.en: I'm an assistant professor of business administration.
sentences.zh: 请求中唯一不同的地方是什么？

sentences.en: Michael Luca and his colleagues, Benjamin Adelman and Dan Savierski, sent out fake Airbnb requests to real-life hosts.
sentences.zh: 附带的个人资料要么是听起来像非裔美国人的名字，要么是听起来像白人的名字。

sentences.en: So we sent out 6,400 requests to stay with people.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如，布拉德（Brad）在爱彼迎上收到的回复数量和贾马尔（Jamal）一样吗？

sentences.en: And we kept every request the same.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到，非裔美国房客相对于白人房客，回复率和接受率有非常大的差异。

sentences.en: The only thing that was different about the requests?
sentences.zh: 在其他条件不变的情况下，拥有一个非裔美国人的名字，在爱彼迎上被接受为房客的几率大约会降低15%。

sentences.en: The profiles attached to them either had African-American-sounding names or white-sounding names.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，爱彼迎已经不再是什么小初创公司了。

sentences.en: So, like, does Brad get the same number of responses on Airbnb as Jamal?
sentences.zh: 它是全球酒店业最大的参与者之一。

sentences.en: We could see that there was a very different response rate and acceptance rate for African-American guests relative to white guests.
sentences.zh: 我们先不谈爱彼迎，而是从另一个你可能听说过的在线平台——脸书（Facebook）说起。

sentences.en: Having an African-American name leads to roughly a 15 percent lower chance of being accepted as a guest on Airbnb relative to having a distinctively white name holding all else constant.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我正在刷脸书，收到了一条好友请求。

sentences.en: To put this in perspective, Airbnb isn't some little startup anymore.
sentences.zh: 我对人脸和名字的记忆力不太好，

sentences.en: It's one of the largest players in the hotel industry worldwide.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在想，自己是否在什么地方见过这个人。

sentences.en: In 2015, more than 2 million listings were offered on the platform from hosts around the world.
sentences.zh: 2015年，该平台上有来自全球各地的房东提供了超过200万个房源。

sentences.en: That's nearly four times as many rooms as the Marriott hotel chain.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是万豪连锁酒店房间数量的四倍。

sentences.en: You can even rent a castle.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以租下一座城堡。

sentences.en: And it's not just vacation rentals.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是度假租赁。

sentences.en: People are finding housing on this platform for months at a time.
sentences.zh: 人们正在该平台上寻找长达数月的住所。

sentences.en: So discrimination on Airbnb is discrimination in the housing market.
sentences.zh: 因此，Airbnb上的歧视就是住房市场中的歧视。

sentences.en: Michael Luca and his colleagues think people could be discriminating without even knowing it.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·卢卡（Michael Luca）和他的同事认为，人们可能在不知不觉中就产生了歧视。

sentences.en: But bias for a lot of people is something that is accidental.
sentences.zh: 但对许多人来说，偏见往往是无意间产生的。

sentences.en: What Michael Luca is talking about is unconscious bias, these hidden associations we have that affect our behavior without us realizing it.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·卢卡所说的是无意识偏见，即我们内心深处那些在不知不觉中影响我们行为的隐性联想。

sentences.en: It's unlikely that most hosts are saying to themselves, I'm going to reject this person because I don't want to rent to a black person.
sentences.zh: 大多数房东不太可能对自己说：“我要拒绝这个人，因为我不想租给黑人。”

sentences.en: I mean, maybe some people are intentionally discriminating.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也许有些人确实在蓄意歧视。

sentences.en: There are probably some people like that.
sentences.zh: 可能确实存在这样的人。

sentences.en: But Michael Luca suspects the way Airbnb's platform is designed is triggering the associations people have of some racial groups.
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔·卢卡怀疑，Airbnb平台的运作方式触发了人们对某些种族群体的刻板印象。

sentences.en: So because names and photos are the first thing people see, it may also be one of the first things they consider, consciously or unconsciously, when choosing a place to stay.
sentences.zh: 因此，由于姓名和照片是人们首先看到的信息，这可能也是他们在选择住宿时，无论是有意还是无意，最先考虑的因素之一。

sentences.en: He and his colleagues looked at five major cities in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他和同事们调查了美国五个主要城市。

sentences.en: And discrimination was happening across the board.
sentences.zh: 歧视现象在各个层面都在发生。

sentences.en: We saw that there was discrimination among cheap listings, expensive listings, in diverse neighborhoods, in homogenous neighborhoods, among white hosts,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，无论是在廉价房源还是昂贵房源，在多元化社区还是同质化社区，在白人房东中，

sentences.en: and among African-American hosts.
sentences.zh: 以及在非裔美国人房东中，都存在歧视现象。

sentences.en: I actually spoke to Mike Luca last week.
sentences.zh: 我上周确实和迈克·卢卡谈过。

sentences.en: That's David King, the brand new director of diversity and belonging at Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 那是大卫·金（David King），Airbnb新任多元化与归属感总监。

sentences.en: He knows this is a problem, and he wants Airbnb to be a leader on fixing it.
sentences.zh: 他知道这是一个问题，并希望Airbnb能带头解决它。

sentences.en: There is a racial bias in platforms, and we are working with Mike Luca and any other external interested parties in how do we address and fix this problem.
sentences.zh: 平台确实存在种族偏见，我们正在与迈克·卢卡及其他任何相关外部方合作，探讨如何应对并解决这一问题。

sentences.en: David King also pointed out there's a lot of opportunity for Airbnb to do good.
sentences.zh: 大卫·金还指出，Airbnb有很多机会可以发挥积极作用。

sentences.en: They're bringing together people from all different backgrounds who wouldn't normally meet.
sentences.zh: 他们正在将来自不同背景、原本可能不会相遇的人们聚集在一起。

sentences.en: We've done some recent reports in Chicago and New York pointing out that underserved communities, especially African-American communities,
sentences.zh: 我们最近在芝加哥和纽约做了一些报告，指出那些服务不足的社区，尤其是非裔美国人社区，

sentences.en: have benefited quite a bit from our platform, usually in neighborhoods where there are few hotels.
sentences.zh: 从我们的平台中受益匪浅，通常是在那些酒店稀少的社区。

sentences.en: One of those neighborhoods with few hotels lies east of the Anacostia River in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 其中一个酒店稀少的社区位于华盛顿特区的阿纳科斯蒂亚河（Anacostia River）以东。

sentences.en: There are lots of big-box stores and empty lots, but also row houses and families that go back generations.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多大型连锁店和空地，但也有世代居住的联排别墅和家庭。

sentences.en: We went there to visit Airbnb host Cinta Keeling.
sentences.zh: 我们去那里拜访了Airbnb房东辛塔·基林（Cinta Keeling）。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 你好，你好吗？

sentences.en: Cinta owns a three-story townhouse in a new development.
sentences.zh: 辛塔在一个新开发区拥有一栋三层联排别墅。

sentences.en: She rents out two rooms on Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 她在Airbnb上出租两个房间。

sentences.en: There's a fitness room, cable and high-speed internet, solar panels, and slippers for all of her guests.
sentences.zh: 那里有健身房、有线电视和高速网络、太阳能电池板，还为所有客人准备了拖鞋。

sentences.en: I love the slippers, first of all.
sentences.zh: 首先，我非常喜欢这些拖鞋。

sentences.en: Cinta is a super host, and we're not just saying that because of the slippers.
sentences.zh: 辛塔是一位“超赞房东”，我们这么说不仅仅是因为拖鞋。

sentences.en: It's an official designation she's earned from Airbnb, based on positive reviews from her guests,
sentences.zh: 这是她从Airbnb获得的官方认证，基于客人的好评，

sentences.en: her responsiveness to booking requests, and the fact that she's never canceled a booking.
sentences.zh: 她对预订请求的响应速度，以及她从未取消过预订的事实。

sentences.en: It shows Airbnb travelers she's been verified as a good person to stay with.
sentences.zh: 这向Airbnb的旅行者证明，她已被核实为一位值得信赖的房东。

sentences.en: Cinta says as a Black host in a Black neighborhood, that's important.
sentences.zh: 辛塔说，作为黑人社区里的黑人房东，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: She feels like she gets held to a higher standard than other hosts.
sentences.zh: 她觉得比起其他房东，自己受到了更高的标准要求。

sentences.en: This neighborhood's called Capital View, and it's 98% African American, double-digit unemployment.
sentences.zh: 这个社区叫“首都景观”（Capital View），98%是非裔美国人，失业率达到两位数。

sentences.en: We asked Cinta whether her race and the racial composition of her neighborhood made it harder to get guests.
sentences.zh: 我们问辛塔，她的种族和社区的种族构成是否让她更难获得客源。

sentences.en: And she said...
sentences.zh: 她说……

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I've had some instances where people will ask me all these questions about it's unsafe,
sentences.zh: 是的，不瞒你说，我遇到过一些情况，人们会问我各种关于安全的问题，

sentences.en: and I'll say, you know, I'm a Black Filipino woman, we take great pride in our community,
sentences.zh: 我会说，你知道，我是非裔菲律宾混血女性，我们为我们的社区感到自豪，

sentences.en: this is absolutely a good place for you to stay, and I'll say those things, and then there'll be crickets.
sentences.zh: 这里绝对是一个适合你居住的好地方，我说完这些，然后就没下文了。

sentences.en: They'll just not book.
sentences.zh: 他们就是不预订。

sentences.en: But Cinta also said there were great things about Airbnb.
sentences.zh: 但辛塔也表示，Airbnb也有很多优点。

sentences.en: For one thing, it brings her a steady-second income.
sentences.zh: 首先，它为她带来了稳定的第二收入。

sentences.en: Airbnb brings business to the stores and restaurants that don't typically benefit from the tourism industry.
sentences.zh: Airbnb为那些通常无法从旅游业中获益的商店和餐馆带来了生意。

sentences.en: Airbnb's slogan is, belong anywhere, and there's some truth to it.
sentences.zh: Airbnb的口号是“家在四方”（belong anywhere），这确实有一定道理。

sentences.en: Cinta Keeling told us a story about one of her guests that drove this message home.
sentences.zh: 辛塔·基林给我们讲了一个关于她客人的故事，深刻地印证了这一点。

sentences.en: He came back from being out for the day and told her...
sentences.zh: 他那天出门回来后告诉她……

sentences.en: I took the bus back, and I was the only white person on the bus.
sentences.zh: 我坐公交车回来，车上只有我一个白人。

sentences.en: And it was all these Black people.
sentences.zh: 周围全是黑人。

sentences.en: And I asked myself, were they going to hurt me?
sentences.zh: 我问自己，他们会伤害我吗？

sentences.en: Am I unsafe?
sentences.zh: 我不安全吗？

sentences.en: And then I realized they weren't hurting me, and nothing was going to happen to me.
sentences.zh: 然后我意识到他们并没有伤害我，什么事也不会发生在我身上。

sentences.en: Like, they were just sitting there normal.
sentences.zh: 就像，他们只是坐在那里，很正常。

sentences.en: And he was saying this in a way that he was like he mentally realized the horridness of what he was saying,
sentences.zh: 他说这些话的时候，似乎在精神上意识到了自己所言的荒谬，

sentences.en: but at the same time, he was just being honest about what he was thinking,
sentences.zh: 但同时，他只是在坦诚地表达自己的想法，

sentences.en: and that he arrived at the stop and just said, come off.
sentences.zh: 他到了站就下车了。

sentences.en: And, like, nothing had happened to him, and it was just this shock.
sentences.zh: 就像，什么事都没发生，这让他感到震惊。

sentences.en: Cinta says she knows that some people won't rent from her because she's a Black host in a predominantly Black neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 辛塔说她知道有些人不会租她的房，因为她是黑人社区里的黑人房东。

sentences.en: But here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于。

sentences.en: She's glad those people don't book with her.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴那些人没有预订她的房。

sentences.en: The strange thing about Airbnb that makes it tough is I really don't want a racist guest in my house
sentences.zh: Airbnb最棘手的地方在于，我真的不想让种族主义者住进我的房子，

sentences.en: because I live here in this space, so I don't need to feel uncomfortable, you know, the other way.
sentences.zh: 因为我就住在这里，所以我不需要感到不舒服，你懂的，反之亦然。

sentences.en: But if you just feel like, well, you know, maybe I'll give this a shot, then I'm willing to be open-minded.
sentences.zh: 但如果你只是觉得，好吧，也许我可以试一试，那么我愿意保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: The fact is, Airbnb is not the same thing as a major hotel chain.
sentences.zh: 事实是，Airbnb与大型连锁酒店并不一样。

sentences.en: Hosts have discretion on the platform.
sentences.zh: 房东在平台上拥有自主权。

sentences.en: But guests don't have the same legal recourse as hotel customers if they feel they've been discriminated againSt.
sentences.zh: 但如果客人感到受到歧视，他们无法像酒店客户那样获得同样的法律救济。

sentences.en: We spoke to a couple lawyers for this story, and the legal picture is a little murky here.
sentences.zh: 我们为这个故事采访了几位律师，法律层面在这里有点模糊。

sentences.en: It isn't clear who, if anyone, is liable for discrimination on a web-based platform.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚在基于网络的平台上，谁（如果有的话）应对歧视负责。

sentences.en: So Airbnb does offer this opportunity to experience different cultures, to meet people you wouldn't normally meet.
sentences.zh: 所以Airbnb确实提供了体验不同文化、结识平时遇不到的人的机会。

sentences.en: But sometimes, hidden bias is getting in the way.
sentences.zh: 但有时，隐性偏见却成了阻碍。

sentences.en: And people like Cortina and Cinta are paying the price.
sentences.zh: 而像科蒂娜（Cortina）和辛塔这样的人正在付出代价。

sentences.en: Producers Maggie Penman and Max Nestrack.
sentences.zh: 制作人：玛吉·彭曼（Maggie Penman）和马克斯·内斯特拉克（Max Nestrack）。

sentences.en: When we come back, Maggie and I are going to talk about the steps Airbnb is taking to address these issues since our story first aired in April.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我和玛吉将讨论自我们四月份首次播出该报道以来，Airbnb为解决这些问题所采取的措施。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐形大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantham）。

sentences.en: We're exploring the many ways in which the sharing economy might allow hidden biases to flourish.
sentences.zh: 我们正在探索共享经济可能导致隐性偏见滋生的多种方式。

sentences.en: As apps in the sharing economy become an increasingly large part of our lives, they have the potential to create great disparities.
sentences.zh: 随着共享经济中的应用程序在我们生活中占据越来越大的比重，它们有可能造成巨大的差异。

sentences.en: The latest twist on the age-old problem of cabs that don't stop to pick up black people.
sentences.zh: 这是出租车拒载黑人这一古老问题的最新变体。

sentences.en: A lot has happened since our story first aired.
sentences.zh: 自我们的报道首次播出以来，发生了许多变化。

sentences.en: The hashtag Cortina started, Airbnb while black, went viral.
sentences.zh: 科蒂娜发起的标签“#AirbnbWhileBlack”（身为黑人使用Airbnb）在网上疯传。

sentences.en: News organizations all over the country picked up the story.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的新闻机构都报道了这个故事。

sentences.en: Airbnb hired a team of heavy hitters to address these issues, including Laura Murphy of the ACLU and Eric Holder, the former Attorney General.
sentences.zh: Airbnb聘请了一个重量级团队来解决这些问题，其中包括美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）的劳拉·墨菲（Laura Murphy）和前司法部长埃里克·霍尔德（Eric Holder）。

sentences.en: They conducted a 90-day review to look at the problem, and they've just released a report announcing changes based on their findings.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了为期90天的审查以审视该问题，并刚刚发布了一份报告，宣布根据调查结果进行改革。

sentences.en: I'm in the studio now with Maggie Penman to talk a little bit about this issue and get an update on what Airbnb is doing.
sentences.zh: 我现在在演播室与玛吉·彭曼讨论这个问题，并了解Airbnb正在采取的最新行动。

sentences.en: Hi, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 你好，玛吉。

sentences.en: Hey, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 你好，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: Back when we aired this episode, Maggie, Airbnb was already offering a way for hosts and guests to get around possible prejudice.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，在我们播出这期节目时，Airbnb就已经为房东和客人提供了一种规避潜在偏见的方法。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The platform has long offered this feature called Instant Book.
sentences.zh: 该平台长期以来一直提供一项名为“即时预订”（Instant Book）的功能。

sentences.en: And normally when you want to book a place on Airbnb, you have to put in a request and the host accepts or denies it.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当你想在Airbnb上预订房源时，你必须提交申请，然后由房东接受或拒绝。

sentences.en: But with Instant Book, you are accepted immediately.
sentences.zh: 但使用“即时预订”，你的申请会被立即接受。

sentences.en: And one of the big changes that they just announced is the company is planning to make this feature much more widely available.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚宣布的一项重大改革是，公司计划让这一功能得到更广泛的应用。

sentences.en: Let me try and understand this.
sentences.zh: 让我试着理解一下。

sentences.en: What would incentivize hosts to offer this option?
sentences.zh: 什么会激励房东提供这个选项？

sentences.en: Well, it's much more convenient for guests, so I think you're more likely to get your place booked.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这对客人来说更方便，所以我认为你的房源被预订的可能性会更高。

sentences.en: And it can also be more convenient for hosts.
sentences.zh: 而且这对房东来说也可能更方便。

sentences.en: Let's say you're renting out your whole home.
sentences.zh: 假设你正在出租整套房子。

sentences.en: Instant Book might just be easier for you.
sentences.zh: “即时预订”对你来说可能更简单。

sentences.en: Max and I talked with someone who used this feature to circumvent what he saw as discrimination.
sentences.zh: 我和马克斯采访了一位使用此功能来规避他所认为的歧视的人。

sentences.en: Very much like Kurtina Crittenden, Reed Kennedy is African-American, and he says he was having trouble getting his requests accepted.
sentences.zh: 和科蒂娜·克里滕登（Cortina Crittenden）非常相似，里德·肯尼迪（Reed Kennedy）也是非裔美国人，他说他在申请预订时遇到了困难。

sentences.en: And so after being rejected, I think in that case four times within the same day for reasons, again, that weren't specified, I started to see a pattern.
sentences.zh: 所以，在同一天内被拒绝了四次，而且原因不明，我开始看出其中的规律了。

sentences.en: He complained to Airbnb, and Airbnb gave him a credit.
sentences.zh: 他向Airbnb投诉，Airbnb给了他一笔抵用金。

sentences.en: But, of course, if your problem is that you are not able to book a place, getting a credit to book another place doesn't really help you very much.
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果你的问题是你无法预订到房间，获得抵用金去预订另一个房间并不能真正解决问题。

sentences.en: So he tried the Instant Book feature.
sentences.zh: 所以他尝试了“即时预订”功能。

sentences.en: And ironically, the host was a black man who may have been using the Instant Book feature for the same reason I was.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，那位房东是一位黑人，他可能也是出于和我同样的原因在使用“即时预订”功能。

sentences.en: Airbnb said in their statement that they hope to have a million listings available for Instant Book by January,
sentences.zh: Airbnb在声明中表示，他们希望到一月份能有100万个房源支持“即时预订”，

sentences.en: and they think this is going to start to address some of these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这将开始解决其中一些问题。

sentences.en: So in some ways, this could be a design solution for the psychological problem of bias.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，这可能是针对偏见这一心理问题的设计解决方案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is similar to a solution Michael Luca came up with.
sentences.zh: 这与迈克尔·卢卡提出的解决方案类似。

sentences.en: That's the researcher at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 也就是那位哈佛的研究员。

sentences.en: He worked with a computer scientist to develop a Google Chrome plugin called DeBias Yourself,
sentences.zh: 他与一位计算机科学家合作开发了一个名为“DeBias Yourself”的谷歌浏览器插件，

sentences.en: and it removes photos and names from people's profiles so users can't discriminate even by accident.
sentences.zh: 它可以从个人资料中移除照片和姓名，这样用户就不会因为偏见而产生歧视。

sentences.en: He said he actually got this idea from orchestras.
sentences.zh: 他说这个想法其实源于管弦乐队。

sentences.en: It used to be that orchestras were overwhelmingly male, and many people might have thought, oh, well, maybe there are just more male musicians,
sentences.zh: 过去，管弦乐队中男性占绝大多数，许多人可能认为，哦，也许只是男性音乐家更多，

sentences.en: or maybe they're just better than female musicians.
sentences.zh: 或者他们比女性音乐家更优秀。

sentences.en: But then this started to shift, and orchestras became more and more gender balanced.
sentences.zh: 但后来情况开始转变，管弦乐队的性别比例变得越来越平衡。

sentences.en: When a couple of researchers tried to figure out why, they found that many auditions had switched to being blind,
sentences.zh: 当几位研究人员试图找出原因时，他们发现许多试演已经改为盲选，

sentences.en: which meant judges had gone from watching the performers to just listening to them play from behind a screen.
sentences.zh: 这意味着评委不再观看表演者，而是只在屏风后聆听他们的演奏。

sentences.en: Mike Luca thinks that Airbnb should be doing the same thing on a larger scale, and this step of increasing Instant Book is sort of moving in that direction.
sentences.zh: 迈克·卢卡认为Airbnb应该在更大范围内采取同样的做法，而增加“即时预订”这一步正是在朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: One of the things that I love about the digital world is that it gives us the opportunity to choose exactly where to put screens and where not to put screens.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢数字世界的一点是，它让我们有机会选择在哪里设置屏障，在哪里不设置屏障。

sentences.en: So I think we have a host of new decisions that we can make as market designers that will decide how inclusive a society we have or how much discrimination we want to encourage or allow.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，作为市场设计者，我们有一系列新的决策可以做出，这将决定我们拥有一个多么包容的社会，或者我们想要鼓励或允许多少歧视。

sentences.en: Here's the interesting thing, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，玛吉。

sentences.en: One of the attractive things about Airbnb and the sharing economy in general is that people don't feel like they're walking into an anonymous place.
sentences.zh: Airbnb和整个共享经济的一个吸引人之处在于，人们不会觉得他们走进了一个匿名的地方。

sentences.en: You know, they feel like they know the people with whom they're renting a home.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们觉得他们了解租房给他们的人。

sentences.en: So there's some balance between hiding information from people and revealing information that can exacerbate these biases.
sentences.zh: 因此，在向人们隐瞒信息和披露可能加剧这些偏见的信息之间，存在某种平衡。

sentences.en: I remember talking to Raj Ghoshal.
sentences.zh: 我记得曾与拉杰·戈沙尔（Raj Ghoshal）交谈过。

sentences.en: This is the sociologist who did the study looking at racial disparities in roommate searches.
sentences.zh: 他是一位社会学家，曾研究过室友搜索中的种族差异。

sentences.en: He told me that maybe the focus should be on playing up some kinds of information.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，重点也许应该放在强调某些类型的信息上。

sentences.en: Perhaps colleges and universities can play a role in this,
sentences.zh: 也许学院和大学可以在这方面发挥作用，

sentences.en: and perhaps websites like Craigslist or roommates.com could do more to actually front-load information about people's living habits or cultural identities,
sentences.zh: 也许像Craigslist或roommates.com这样的网站可以做更多工作，真正地预先展示关于人们生活习惯或文化身份的信息，

sentences.en: what time people get up and go to bed, what level of messy they are, that sort of thing, rather than immediately hitting people over the head with somebody's name.
sentences.zh: 比如人们起床和睡觉的时间、整洁程度等等，而不是一上来就用某人的名字给人们造成刻板印象。

sentences.en: Just because, you know, all the evidence we have, evidence from other studies, just suggests that, like, race in names is such a powerful signal to people
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们掌握的所有证据，来自其他研究的证据，都表明名字中的种族信息对人们来说是一个强烈的信号，

sentences.en: that we probably don't actually want it to be the first thing or the immediate thing that people see and are deciding by.
sentences.zh: 以至于我们可能并不希望它是人们看到的第一件事，或者人们据此做出决定的首要因素。

sentences.en: That's a really interesting point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的观点。

sentences.en: And I think that's why Airbnb hasn't done what some people were suggesting, which was to totally eliminate names or photos,
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是为什么Airbnb没有采取一些人建议的做法，即完全消除姓名或照片，

sentences.en: because that lack of anonymity is definitely part of the appeal.
sentences.zh: 因为这种非匿名性绝对是其吸引力的一部分。

sentences.en: Is the company doing anything else to try and eliminate discrimination?
sentences.zh: 公司还在采取其他措施来消除歧视吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So in addition to building up that instant book option, they're also asking everyone who uses the platform to commit to a stronger non-discrimination policy.
sentences.zh: 除了加强“即时预订”选项外，他们还要求所有使用该平台的人承诺遵守更严格的反歧视政策。

sentences.en: And they're working on an anti-bias training that's going to be offered on the site.
sentences.zh: 他们正在开发一种反偏见培训，并将会在网站上提供。

sentences.en: But the most radical thing they're doing is implementing what they call an open doors policy.
sentences.zh: 但他们正在采取的最激进的措施是实施所谓的“敞开大门政策”（open doors policy）。

sentences.en: If any person anywhere in the world feels they can't get a booking because they're being discriminated against,
sentences.zh: 如果世界上任何地方的任何人觉得他们因为受到歧视而无法预订房间，

sentences.en: Airbnb will find them a similar place to stay.
sentences.zh: Airbnb 将会为他们找到类似的住宿地点。

sentences.en: If there isn't anything available on Airbnb, they'll find accommodation for them elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 如果 Airbnb 上没有空房，他们也会在其他地方为这些人找到住处。

sentences.en: So this is clearly an effort to address concerns about discrimination.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然是为了解决歧视问题所做出的努力。

sentences.en: But a policy like this would really only help guests who are having trouble booking a room,
sentences.zh: 但这样的政策实际上只能帮助那些在预订房间时遇到困难的房客，

sentences.en: not hosts who are trying to rent a room.
sentences.zh: 而无法帮助那些试图出租房间的房东。

sentences.en: The company said in the statement this is the beginning, not the end, of their effort to combat bias.
sentences.zh: 该公司在声明中表示，这只是他们打击偏见努力的开始，而非终点。

sentences.en: So maybe in the coming months we'll see features or policies designed to help hosts too.
sentences.zh: 所以也许在接下来的几个月里，我们会看到旨在帮助房东的功能或政策出台。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: Thanks so much, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，Maggie。

sentences.en: Thanks, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Shankar。

sentences.zh: 本期《Hidden Brain》播客由 Maggie Penman 和 Max Nestrack 制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的监制是 Tara Boyle。

sentences.zh: Rene Klar 负责管理我们的 Facebook 和 Twitter 页面。

sentences.en: Check out the hashtag,
sentences.zh: 请查看标签，

sentences.en: Kurtina started, Airbnb while black.
sentences.zh: 由 Kurtina 发起的“Airbnb while black”（黑人使用 Airbnb 的经历）。

sentences.en: An incredible conversation has unfolded there over the last few months.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，那里展开了一场令人难以置信的对话。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham, and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 我是 Shankar Vedantham，这是 NPR。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for watching.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的收看。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是 Shankar Vedantham。
